screen.n_fine: 1 value in range | {n} values in range
screen.advice_co2: Open a window, or turn the ventilation up.
screen.advice_pm25: Switch on the cooker hood, put out candles, or run an air purifier.
screen.advice_pm10: Let the dust settle, then air the room.
screen.advice_voc: Air the room, and put away what smells.
screen.advice_nox: Switch on the cooker hood and air the room.
screen.advice_temperature_high: Shade the windows, or cool the room.
screen.advice_temperature_low: Turn the heating up a little.
screen.advice_humidity_high: Air the room, or run a dehumidifier.
screen.advice_humidity_low: Run a humidifier, or set the heating a little lower.
screen.advice_swing: Keep it even: air briefly, and let a humidifier hold one level.
screen.advice_fine: Nothing to do: the air is fine for this room.
screen.cause_co2: People breathing in a closed room. A lot of it makes you tired and less sharp.
screen.cause_pm25: Fine dust: mostly cooking, candles, a wood stove or smoke from outside.
screen.cause_pm10: Coarser dust that was stirred up: vacuuming, sanding, pollen.
screen.cause_voc: Fumes of everyday things: cleaning products, paint, glue, new furniture, cooking.
screen.cause_nox: Gases of burning: a gas hob, a stove, candles, or traffic outside.
screen.cause_temperature_high: Sun on the windows, the heating, or many people in the room.
screen.cause_temperature_low: The heating is low, or a window is open.
screen.cause_humidity_high: Showering, cooking, drying laundry, or too little fresh air.
screen.cause_humidity_low: Heating dries the air, most of all in winter.
screen.cause_swing: How far the humidity moved in 24 hours. Heating that cycles, airing and a humidifier that switches make it move.
screen.in_range: In range for this room. Nothing to do.

app.name: Air quality
app.summary: One verdict for the air of a room, from the sensors you choose, judged for the kind of room it is.
app.opt_room_hint: Sets what counts as good here: a bedroom wants cooler, fresher air than a workshop.
